new_features: Optional state-conditioned legally masked policy imitation
compatibility.order_semantics: The updated upstream solver discovers piece order automatically and imposes no external mandatory order. The supplemental decision benchmark explicitly defines sorted movable labels as its goal-prefix order only to make its one-step oracle deterministic; this is an evaluation policy, not an upstream legality constraint.
compatibility.old_benchmark_preserved: Existing arcade/blockstar.py and its original eight-case paired benchmark remain pinned to f40b338. The supplement uses this separate module and new commit pin.
compatibility.invalid_moves: The updated Puzzle.apply_move raises ValueError transactionally; upstream old code silently ignored invalid actions. All original positive legal slides still agree.

agentformer.reason: Updated optional imitation policy is import-safe, state-conditioned, uses legal/visited-state masks and saves checkpoints, but no pretrained checkpoint is tracked. No retraining performed. Published 20-step smoke sample was legal and unsolved.

limitations: Original versus updated measured solver budgets differ; compare slide scores descriptively, not as an equal-compute trial.
Official certificate verification time is reported separately from discovery runtime.
37 and64 slides are verified scores, not proven global optima.
Two one-step scenario probes do not establish full-puzzle model solve performance.
The new deterministic benchmark prefix order is a declared oracle policy and is not mandated by upstream.
